programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Our cities are being attacked, overrun and overwhelmed with pests and invasive species bent on decimating our homes and threatening our well being. What happens if these urban invaders continue to expand their territory and occupy our safe haven? Is it just a matter of time before an emerging deadly disease carried by one of those urban invaders creates havoc in our big cities?

Space Greed S1 - "Terraforming: Can We Build A Planet B?"
programme.sub-title: Terraforming: Can We Build A Planet B?
programme.desc: Once we’ve managed to get a handle on building structures to help us live on the harsh, dangerous surfaces of other celestial bodies -- why stop there?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Carbon Costs: Is Space Exploration Even Worth It?"
programme.sub-title: Carbon Costs: Is Space Exploration Even Worth It?
programme.desc: Each rocket that gets fired off has an impact on the atmosphere. Will Earth be able to survive hundreds, or even thousands, of fuel-burning rocket launches every year.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Looting The Moon For Trillions of Dollars"
programme.sub-title: Looting The Moon For Trillions of Dollars
programme.desc: With NASA planning to make a manned return trip to the moon by 2024, how long until some giant corporation turns moon dust into a cosmic-sized payday?

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "From There To Here"
programme.desc: The first phase of this journey is complete, now commences the second, with robotics, advanced technologies and sheer daring we are now going where before we only dreamt.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "Return To The Moon"
programme.desc: Few have walked on the moon's surface, though her allure remains strong, once again we are glancing her way with renewed interest and with a view to return very soon.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Inner Worlds"
programme.desc: Venus the first and brightest star in the evening sky, and Mercury fleeting across the solar disk. As we begin to take a closer look at our companions they are posing more questions than answers.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "Next Stop Mars"
programme.desc: It has fired our imaginations for millennia, Mars, the God of War and the source of Man's science fictional demise. It is the only other place in our solar system than Man might one day call home.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Planet Makers"
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Ice Giants"
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us new insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Moons of Olympus"
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. All are worthy of much more scrutiny.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: We study our Sun closely, and like a Rosetta stone it can reveal the secrets of all the other stars above.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "Exo Planets"
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "Edge of the Universe"
programme.desc: What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Alien Worlds"
programme.desc: A virtual scalpel dissects methane lakes and icy crusts to reveal hidden oceans and water-erupting volcanoes on distant moons.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Asteroids"
programme.desc: By stripping the crust and peeling back craters, CGI exposes the hidden minerals and refueling potential locked inside these asteroid worlds.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Black Holes"
programme.desc: Stripping away cosmic layers with CGI, this film reveals how black holes act as both destructive abysses and vital anchors for our galaxy.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Comets"
programme.desc: Peeling back the dusty coma via CGI, this film explores if icy comets brought water and life to Earth while tracking the threats they pose.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Mars"
programme.desc: Beneath the red dust, CGI peels away Martian volcanoes and ice to reveal a once-Earth-like world and the challenges of future human missions.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: By stripping away the Sun's boiling plasma layers, this CGI study reveals the nuclear core that fuels our world while tracking lethal solar storms.

programme.title: Beyond Our Earth S1 - "In Our Orbit"
programme.desc: Humanity's push into Earth's orbit spans Cold War space race milestones, station endurance tests, and international cooperation on the ISS.

programme.title: Beyond Our Earth S1 - "Conquering the Moon"
programme.desc: Lunar exploration progresses from early Soviet probe flybys and Apollo landings to robotic rovers and 21st-century water ice discoveries.

programme.title: Beyond Our Earth S1 - "The Inner System"
programme.desc: Probes sent to Venus, Mercury, and Mars uncover clues about planetary formation, solar winds, and potential sites for future colonies.

programme.title: Beyond Our Earth S1 - "Beyond the Belts"
programme.desc: Voyager and Cassini missions tour the outer solar system, investigating gas giants, icy moons, Pluto, and a hypothetical Planet Nine.

programme.title: Beyond Our Earth S1 - "Searching The Heavens"
programme.desc: Telescopic innovations from Galileo to Hubble and James Webb expand cosmic maps, revealing distant galaxies and habitable exoplanets.

programme.title: Beyond Our Earth S1 - "Our Expanding Universe"
programme.desc: Cosmic observations push physical theories to their limits, exploring spacetime relativity, black holes, dark matter, and accelerated expansion.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Preparing for Mars"
programme.desc: Join host Emily Calandrelli as she talks to scientists about the next stop in our solar system – Mars.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Astronaut Training"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli travels to Johnson Space Center to get an inside look at what it takes to be an astronaut.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Robots in Space"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli explores the robots that are changing the way we explore space - and helping people on earth.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Life Beyond Earth"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli assembles an investigative team to tackle one of the biggest questions of our time: Are we alone?

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Asteroids"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli speaks to experts who are learning everything they can about asteroids and their potential impact on earth.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Space Balloons"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits with experts to discuss the scientific advantages of high altitude balloons.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Journey to the Moon"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli meets with scientists to discuss the creation, composition and history of the Earth’s nearest neighbor: The Moon.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Space Tourism"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli explores the next great travel destination: Outer Space.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Rockets & Propulsion"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli examines how rockets are made, how they blast off, and how they make their way through the Earth’s atmosphere.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Satellites"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli delves into the world of satellites.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "The All-Powerful Sun"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli meets with a team of scientists to discuss the dynamic, explosive, and dangerous center of the Solar System: the Sun.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Extreme Space"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli meets with a team of scientists to discuss the death of massive stars in the Universe.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Why We Explore"
programme.desc: Through the eyes of astronauts, entrepreneurs, and inventors, host Emily Calandrelli asks one of the key questions of Outer Space: Why do we explore?

programme.title: Rock of Ages S1 - "Basalt"
programme.desc: In this episode we’re exploring Hawaii to show us rocks in motion. We see the beauty of rocks after the volcano’s magma turns into basalt.

programme.title: Rock of Ages S1 - "Sandstone"
programme.desc: In this episode we travel 3.700 miles through the unprotected landscape of the American West. From Utah to New Mexico. By entering the crevice, the unbelievable play of colours begins, this is sandstone.

programme.title: Rock of Ages S1 - "Granite"
programme.desc: In this episode we travel to Brittany to find – in Goethe’s words 'the underpinning of the earth' - Granite.

programme.title: Rock of Ages S1 - "Marble"
programme.desc: In this episode we travel through India searching for a rock that is converted by heat pressure within the earth to become what we call marble.

programme.title: Rock of Ages S1 - "Meteorites"
programme.desc: In this episode we go back in time to the edge of a 50.000-year crater. On a highway to Arizona, we followed the sign 'Meteor Crater'. This was the start for a fantastic tour to rocks from another world.

programme.title: Wild Animal Rescue S1 - "Felida Tigers and Lionsrock"
